transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well... I guess I'm here because my eating is just... off. Sometimes I just skip lunch entirely. I just forget. And then other times I'm just standing in the kitchen, eating crackers or whatever sweets are around. Even though... I don't know, nothing really tastes right anyway.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
I suppose so. Most mornings... I just wake up with this heavy, low feeling. It's like... the color has already gone out of the day before I even get dressed.
Have you been hearing or seeing things that other people don’t seem to?
No... not really. I mean... I haven't noticed anything like that.
Are you trying to lose weight?
No... not on purpose. I'm not trying to do that.
How long have you been feeling this low most mornings?
Oh... I don't know exactly. It's been a while. I suppose... maybe about a year and two months. Something like that.
During this past year or so, was there ever a stretch of at least two months when you were not feeling depressed most mornings?

No... I don't think so. Looking back... I guess the sadness and just... not caring about things... it's taken up most of this whole time. Since my sister got sick. Even when the other things... the worries about my records... when those were quieter, the sadness was still there.
During this past year, was there ever a period of at least two weeks when your depression felt clearly worse than usual?
I'm not sure. It all just... blends together, really. I don't remember a specific time it was worse. It's just always there.
During this past year, was there ever a time when you felt worthless nearly every day?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I get down, but... I wouldn't use that word. Not worthless, no.
Have you lost weight without trying to?

I haven't really checked the scale. But... my eating has gotten all turned around. I suppose that's what made me finally come in. Some days I just... forget lunch completely. And other days I'll just stand at the counter eating crackers and sweets... even though nothing tastes right anyway.
Have you had a poor appetite nearly every day during this past year?
I wouldn't say every day... no. It just... fluctuates, I suppose. I don't really keep track of it.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

I suppose... somewhat. I used to go to things. A watercolor class... the quilting circle. Book club, too. But lately... I'll get my bag ready and just leave it by the door. I just... I don't know, I just can't seem to make myself care enough to actually go.
Have you been feeling tired or low on energy nearly every day?
Not especially. I mean... I don't really do enough to get tired out these days. I just... sit in the house mostly. So, I suppose my energy is fine.
Have you been sleeping more than usual?
No... not really. I just sleep my usual amount, I suppose. I haven't noticed any difference.
Have you been having trouble concentrating, such as when reading or following a conversation?

I suppose... a little. Sometimes I just sit there staring at simple things. Like trying to decide whether to call the pharmacy or... or open the mail first. My mind just gets so foggy with it... I usually end up doing neither one.
Have you been feeling hopeless?
I suppose... a little. It's just... well, most mornings I wake up with this heavy sort of... low feeling. It's like the color has just gone out of the day... before I even manage to get dressed.
Have your clothes become noticeably looser lately?

I suppose they might be. It's just... well, my eating has gotten all turned around lately. I guess that's what made me finally come in. Some days I just completely forget about lunch... and other days I'll just stand at the kitchen counter eating crackers and sweets. Not that it matters... nothing really tastes right anyway.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?

I suppose... yes. My body just feels... slowed down lately. It seems like it takes me twice as long just to cross the room... or even button my sweater. But then... well, sometimes I just pace around the house instead. Just walking back and forth with the same papers in my hand... I don't really know.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight without trying to?

I don't really check the scale much. But... well, like I just mentioned a moment ago, my eating is just all turned around. That's really what made me finally come in. With forgetting lunch half the time, or just picking at those crackers and sweets... I suppose I probably have lost some weight. Nothing tastes right anyway, so... I just don't pay it much mind.
During this past year, was there ever a two-week period when you had thoughts that life was not worth living?

I... well, I suppose. I wouldn't say I've made any plans to... to do anything to myself. But... I do sometimes think that... if I just went to sleep and didn't wake up... it might just be easier. A relief, maybe. For everyone.
During this past year, was there ever a two-week period when your depression was clearly worse than usual?

Yes... I suppose so. Looking back... the sadness, and just not caring about much of anything... it's taken up most of this whole period since my sister got sick. Even when the worries about the records were... quieter... the sadness was still there. It's just been a long time of feeling that way.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes depressed mood present most mornings for about 14 months without any remission lasting 2 months, which is most consistent with persistent depressive disorder. She also reports reduced interest, hopelessness, impaired concentration, appetite disturbance with likely weight loss, psychomotor slowing/agitation, and passive death wishes.
